title: Full English Breakfast Bake
description: A twist on the classic full English breakfast, baked in a single dish for convenience and minimal cleanup.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the sausages over medium-high heat, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook, until browned and cooked through.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage mixture, red kidney beans, and British bangers and mash mix.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish and spread evenly.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the mixture is hot and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
